item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Match the Kitchen Window Light

turns.text: Move this candle onto a pale kitchen counter with warm sunlight coming from the upper left. Make the light on the glass and the shadow on the counter match that sunlight, so it looks actually photographed there. Keep the jar and wax the same. Square, no text.

item.tests: Tests physically consistent relighting and cast shadows during background replacement, including transparent glass edges.

answer_sheet.Subject: The candle in its clear glass jar from product-candle.jpg; preserve the jar shape and wax.
answer_sheet.New setting: A pale kitchen counter; the rest of the kitchen is your call.
answer_sheet.Lighting and shadow direction: Warm sunlight from the upper left, with corresponding glass highlights and a shadow extending toward the lower right.
answer_sheet.Style and format: One realistic square photograph at the standard free size, with no added text.

must_haves: The same candle jar and wax are preserved on a pale kitchen counter.
The original wooden shelf and nearby plant are absent.
Warm highlights on the jar are consistent with light arriving from the upper left.
The candle casts a grounded shadow toward the lower right, with no contradictory original shadow.
Transparent glass edges show the new setting naturally rather than retaining shelf or plant fragments.
The output is square with no added text.

turns.text: Move the candle in this pic onto a pale kitchen counter with warm sunlight coming from the upper left. Make the light on the glass and the shadow on the counter match that sunlight, so it looks actually photographed there. Keep the jar and wax the same. Square, no text. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**The cheapest suitable edit is estimated at 5 credits**: one square image at **640 × 640**, using **Flux 2 Klein**, which supports the free plan. The tool lists pricing as “from 5 credits”; I can’t verify a binding account-specific total with the tools available.

I’d replace the background with a pale kitchen counter, match the glass highlights and counter shadow to warm sunlight from the upper left, and preserve the jar, wax, and wick. No added text.

**Cheaper or smaller?** This is already the lowest listed image-edit price and smallest supported output. “Shorter” doesn’t apply to a still image. Background removal alone also costs 5 credits and wouldn’t provide the counter or matched lighting.

Nothing has been generated or charged. Would you like to proceed with this estimated 5-credit option?

style.prompt: Edit the supplied candle photograph. Move this exact candle onto a pale kitchen counter in a softly lit kitchen. Warm natural sunlight enters from the upper left: match the glass reflections, highlights, refraction and wax illumination to that direction, with a realistic contact shadow and cast shadow extending toward the lower right across the counter. Make it look genuinely photographed there, not pasted in. Preserve the original clear cylindrical glass jar, its rim and base geometry, proportions, ivory wax color and fill level, and single unlit wick. Do not redesign the candle. Replace the wooden surface and original plant/background with the pale kitchen-counter setting. Square composition with the candle as the main subject. No text, labels, logos or watermarks.
